Title: What Is Humanities - Sly Academy
Imagine a world without literature, music, art, or philosophy—a world devoid of the creativity and critical thinking that define human culture. According to the National Endowment for the Humanities, engagement in the arts and humanities can foster a deeper understanding of our diverse societies and promote social cohesion. * **Real-world examples and case studies** to illustrate how humanities influence daily life, societal progress, and global culture. * **Interdisciplinary Nature:** The humanities draw upon a variety of fields such as history, philosophy, literature, art, music, and cultural studies. In essence, understanding **what is humanities** means recognizing it as a broad field dedicated to exploring and interpreting the myriad aspects of human culture and experience. * **Modern Developments:** In the 19th and 20th centuries, the humanities expanded to include diverse cultural and social perspectives. * **Real-World Example:** Digital humanities projects, such as online archives of historical documents and interactive art installations, demonstrate how technology can enhance our engagement with cultural heritage and history. They include history, philosophy, cultural studies, and languages—fields that explore every aspect of human experience and contribute to our understanding of society. **A:** Studying humanities equips individuals with critical thinking, cultural awareness, and creative problem-solving skills. **A:** Projects such as digital archives, interactive museum exhibits, and collaborations between artists and scientists (in fields like environmental humanities) showcase how interdisciplinary approaches can enrich our understanding of cultural and societal issues. * **Impact:** Digital humanities make cultural and historical materials more accessible to a global audience, fostering collaborative research and innovative educational tools. * **Definition and Scope:** Humanities is an interdisciplinary field dedicated to studying human culture, history, philosophy, art, and language. * **Diverse Disciplines:** Literature, history, philosophy, arts, and cultural studies collectively offer profound insights into the human experience. * **Modern Trends:** Digital humanities, global studies, interdisciplinary research, and ethical debates highlight the evolving nature of the humanities in our interconnected world. * **Engage with Culture:** Attend local art exhibitions, theater productions, or public lectures that celebrate diverse human experiences. By embracing the humanities, we not only celebrate our rich cultural heritage but also equip ourselves with the critical tools needed to navigate the complexities of modern society.

Faculty scholars all have experience with digital arts and humanities research, and are committed to the interdisciplinary nature of the program. Research undertaken in this graduate program brings together the Humanities, aspects of the Social Sciences, and the Creative Arts. results.content: # Digital Humanities. **Digital Scholarship in the Humanities**  An international, peer-reviewed journal that publishes original contributions on all aspects of digital scholarship in the humanities. **International Journal of Digital Humanities**  A peer-reviewed academic journal focusing on digital media and the development, application, and reflection of digital research methodology in the humanities. **Digital Humanities Quarterly**  An open-access, peer-reviewed journal covering all aspects of digital media in the humanities. **Digital Studies**A bilingual, peer-reviewed journal focusing on digital scholarship across the arts, humanities, and social sciences. **Frontiers in Digital Humanities**This journal bridges the gap between the humanities and technology, publishing interdisciplinary research that applies computational methods to humanities topics, including digital archives, text analysis, and cultural studies. **International Journal of Humanities and Arts Computing**A platform for exploring the use of advanced computing in humanities and arts research, focusing on interdisciplinary methodologies and technical innovation. Title: Call for Applications: 2025 Interdisciplinary Graduate Program in Digital Arts & Humanities, UBC Okanagan – Akimbo Art
# Call for Applications: 2025 Interdisciplinary Graduate Program in Digital Arts & Humanities, UBC Okanagan. #### **Interdisciplinary Graduate Program in Digital Arts & Humanities** **UBC Okanagan, Faculty of Creative and Critical Studies**. Earn an Interdisciplinary MA or PhD in Digital Arts & Humanities at UBC’s Okanagan campus. Research and creative practice undertaken in this graduate program brings computing technologies and makerspace methods together to address such humanities topics as social justice, access, sustainability, ethics, labour, ecology, collaboration, interaction, making, pedagogy, and reading, as well as the ways in which the arts and humanities can pose vital questions about computing technologies. In our Interdisciplinary Graduate Studies degree in Digital Arts & Humanities at UBC Okanagan, students learn to apply arts and humanities frameworks to digital tools and technologies and use digital technologies to explore questions central to the arts and humanities. With the research, teaching, making, and analytical skills they gain in the Digital Arts and Humanities theme, our PhD students will be prepared to pursue academic and alternative academic career paths. Students in the IGS Digital Arts & Humanities program have access to the expertise of diverse, nationally and internationally recognized researchers from a variety of faculties and disciplines in a coherent, thematic framework. During their degree, students will have the opportunity to conduct original research, learn to become effective educators, and work as teaching assistants, as well as acquire knowledge in the professional practices of writing for publication, academic CV development, grant writing, networking, and community-engaged research skills. Students are advised to start the application process two months in advance of the application deadline. gradstudies.ok.ubc.ca/igs/digital-arts-humanities.
